context.why: First story of the feature. Today the editing pages exist three times: additional views of the overview on projects and datasets (Update, Descriptions, Delete), four separately registered pages on samples built on generic bases, and none on measurements. This story lays what every later story stands on: the module fairdm/core/editing.py, the one access rule (RecordEditingPage), the Manage menu (manage_menu and <c-actions.manage>), and the first two pages, edit details and descriptions, on all four record types. It removes the pages those two replace. Delete, key dates, identifiers and keywords are later stories: leave the project and dataset Delete pages, the sample KeyDates and Keywords pages and their generic bases working and reachable from the menu through the component's slot.
plan_sections: D9 (row US-1 and the paragraph on decision 0008)
prior_decisions: decisions.md planning decision D2: 404 only when the viewer may not see the record; a signed-in viewer who may see it and not use the page gets 403; a visitor is redirected to sign in. PrivateRecordNotFoundMixin is not used by the new pages.
decisions.md planning decision D3: the shared Manage menu has no contributors entry; the project's old 'Manage contributors' item is not carried over.

decisions.md planning decision D5: the pages are registered plugins of their own with menu=False, not additional views. A new decision record docs/adr/0026-a-records-editing-pages-are-six-shared-pages.md supersedes 0008; mark 0008 superseded in place and add 0026 to docs/adr/index.md. Use the shape of docs/adr/0025. It must also say that each page states its own access and the rule that reads it lives on the inherited class (how this sits with decision 0012), and that a refused viewer who may see the record gets 403.

Design review, high: a form from registry.get_for_model(type(record)).get_form_class() gets a crispy FormHelper with form_tag True and its own Submit (fairdm/registry/factories.py:93-97). django-mvp's form_view.html already draws the <form> and the Save buttons, and cotton/form/render.html renders a form with a helper through {% crispy %}. A nested <form> ends the outer one early. EditDetails must set helper.form_tag = False and empty helper.inputs on any form that carries a helper. The test asserts exactly one <form> element in the page content and that the submit control is inside it.

Design review: Plugin.get_queryset falls back to the view's own get_queryset when the model has no all_objects (only Dataset has one), and SingleObjectMixin needs a model. RecordEditingPage.get_object() returns base_object so no page depends on a model attribute.

Design review: Overview.directory, crud_views, show_update_action and show_descriptions_action on the project and dataset overviews name the pages you remove (fairdm/core/project/plugins.py:254-276, fairdm/core/dataset/plugins.py:285-315). django-mvp reverses every shown action and lets NoReverseMatch propagate, so remove the update and descriptions entries and the two show_*_action methods in this story. Leave the delete entry, show_delete_action and CRUDDirectoryMixin for US3.

Design review: fairdm.core is not an installed app, so fairdm/core/editing.py is not discovered on its own. Import it at the foot of fairdm/core/project/plugins.py. Move ProjectDatesInline and DatasetDatesInline into fairdm/core/related_records.py in this story so editing.py does not import the two record plugin modules at module level. Resolve the record type's overview class lazily, as ContributionPage.overview does in fairdm/contrib/contributors/plugins/shared.py:336-360.

Request is passed to a form only when its constructor names a `request` parameter, read with inspect.signature. Note DatasetForm takes request as its first positional parameter and ProjectForm as keyword-only.

The name `descriptions` must be free on the sample before the shared page can claim it: the old sample page is named basic-information, and the project and dataset pages are overview-descriptions, so check fairdm/contrib/plugins/checks.py validate_registration for name, segment and URL-name clashes on each of the four models.

tests/test_core/test_project/test_plugins.py:346-365 and tests/test_core/test_dataset/test_plugins.py:204-217 assert that exactly one page offers a record's own attributes and that it is Update. They describe decision 0008 and are among the tests this story rewrites.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given the test classes tasks.md T001 lists, when they are run before T002, then they fail for the reason that the shared pages do not exist yet.

Given a project, a dataset, a demo sample type and a demo measurement type, when someone at each level requests and submits the edit details and descriptions pages and opens each overview, then every outcome in tasks.md T001 holds, the old pages are gone, and the delete, key dates and keywords pages that later stories own still work and are still in the menu.

Given the documentation, when a portal developer reads docs/portal-development/record-editing-pages.md, then it says which pages a registered type receives so far, their addresses, how they are reached and which right opens each, and no page under docs/ names a removed page or address.
